Container.Name: Fanframe
Container.Overview:
An artwork editor for Jellyfin. Pick a show or movie, drop in an image or choose one of the images TVDB, TMDB and Fanart offer, crop it to the shape Jellyfin uses and save it: backdrops, posters, thumbs, logos and banners. Replace, add, delete or reorder single backdrops, preview how Jellyfin will frame a backdrop, and undo any change or restore an earlier version from History.
Setup: create an API key in Jellyfin (Dashboard, API Keys, +) and enter it below with your Jellyfin address. Set a password: anyone who can reach the port can change your artwork.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: jellyfin artwork backdrop poster fanart logo banner crop images
Container.Requires: A Jellyfin server and a Jellyfin API key (Dashboard, API Keys, +).

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: How this container reaches Jellyfin, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8096. Use the server's LAN address, not localhost.

Config.Name: Jellyfin API key
Config.Description: Jellyfin: Dashboard, API Keys, +. Give it its own name (e.g. Fanframe) so you can revoke it later.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Recommended. The page asks for it (any user name). Without it, anyone who can reach the port can change your artwork.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Backups for Undo and History, and settings.

Config.Name: Jellyfin public URL
Config.Description: Optional. The address your browser uses for Jellyfin, for the Open in Jellyfin link. Defaults to the Jellyfin URL.

Config.Name: Media folders read-only
Config.Description: true: images stored next to your media files (like folder.jpg) are shown with a lock and left alone. Set false only if Jellyfin can write to your media folders.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns /config and runs the app.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns /config and runs the app.
